{'role': 'assistant', 'content': [{'type': 'text', 'text': "**Answer to your question: Yes.** `bindBoard`'s `ResizeObserver` is the same bug. Fixed.\n\n## What I found\n\nIn `src/events.ts`, `bindBoard` created `new ResizeObserver(onResize).observe(wrap)` with no reference kept. Two problems:\n\n1. **Not disconnected on destroy** — `Api.destroy()` only called `state.dom.unbind` (which wraps `bindDocument`); the observer kept observing the persistent `wrap` after destroy.\n2. **Duplicated on redraw** — `redrawAll()` calls `bindBoard` unconditionally, and `renderWrap` does `element.innerHTML = ''`, so the board element is recreated each render but `wrap` persists. Each redraw stacked a new observer on the same `wrap`.\n\nThe `contextmenu`/`touchstart`/`mousedown` listeners attach to the recreated board node so they don't pile up, but I added them to the same unbind for completeness.\n\n## Fix\n\n- `bindBoard` now returns `cg.Unbind` that disconnects the observer and removes the three board listeners (`src/events.ts`).\n- `redrawAll` detaches the previous `boardUnbind` before rendering and stores the fresh one (`src/chessground.ts`).\n- `destroy` calls `state.dom.boardUnbind?.()` before `unbind` (`src/api.ts`); added `boardUnbind?: Unbind` to `Dom` (`src/types.ts`).\n- Added `tests/observer.test.ts` (vitest/jsdom, stubbed `ResizeObserver`) asserting one observer, disconnect-on-redraw, disconnect-on-destroy.\n\n## Verification\n\n- `npm test`: 3 files, 4 tests pass (incl. new `observer.test.ts`).\n- `npx tsc --sourceMap --declaration`: clean (`TSC_OK`).\n- Headless Chrome over a local http server (file:// blocks ES modules):\n  - **demo.html loads**: 5 boards, 152 pieces rendered, no console errors.\n  - **Resize**: container 400→700px; `cg-board` re-rendered to 696px (700 − border), internal `ResizeObserver` fired, no errors.\n\nTemp server/probe removed after verification."}], 'api': 'openai-completions', 'provider': 'pod-dsv4', 'model': 'deepseek-v4-flash-0731', 'usage': {'input': 92827, 'output': 491, 'cacheRead': 0, 'cacheWrite': 0, 'totalTokens': 93318, 'cost': {'input': 0, 'output': 0, 'cacheRead': 0, 'cacheWrite': 0, 'total': 0}}, 'stopReason': 'stop', 'timestamp': 1787271672226, 'responseId': 'chatcmpl-8dcd0ae38b429003', 'duration': 2858.88440000001, 'ttft': 808.1638999999996, 'contextSnapshot': {'promptTokens': 92827, 'nonMessageTokens': 5716}}
